status: baseline-v0 — architecture estimates, not selected flight hardware
notes: Closes task sensor-suite-baseline at v0. Mass/power/data are class estimates from published VLF / DAVINCI / VEGA / compact-MS literature, derated for a ~50 kg flush bay. Not a vendor selection. Gondola structure, thermal, UHF, and harness sit on top of science mass.

gondola.notes: Matches mass-budget.json gondola line. Science ~8 kg inside a ~50 kg bay — not a 1 kg pod.

instruments.name: AFN-class autofluorescence nephelometer
instruments.heritage: VLF / MIT AFN class (440 nm laser, scatter + fluorescence)
instruments.role: Time-series particle size, shape, and organics at 50–55 km. Event flag for MS.

instruments.name: Compact TLS / MEMS gas
instruments.heritage: DAVINCI VTLS class; compact TDLAS / MEMS IR. Targets NH3, H2O, SO2; PH3/O2 as mass allows.
instruments.role: Same cloud slab through day, night, and events — not a one-hour vertical profile.

instruments.name: Aerosol / organics MS (LDMS-class)
instruments.heritage: Morning Star ORIGIN / VLF balloon follow-on class. Laser desorption of droplet residue.
instruments.role: Event-triggered when AFN flags fluorescence. Repeated sampling, not one plunge.

instruments.name: Meteorology T / P / wind
instruments.role: Continuous environment. Highest-priority downlink after health.

instruments.name: Envelope 4K camera (upward)
instruments.heritage: COTS CMOS + sapphire or protected fluoropolymer window. Two-camera visual lock.
instruments.role: Fixed bay camera looking up the film (sponsor + gore). Stills first; clips are a luxury.

instruments.name: Deck 4K camera (outward)
instruments.heritage: Same class as cam_env. Not VenDI — we do not image the surface.
instruments.role: Cloud-deck stills. Video only in closest-approach weeks if the link allows.

derived.notes: science_avg_w = sum(power_w * duty_float_day). Image data is duty-cycled and queued behind science; see comms-link.json.
